en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a spa town nestled in a steep forested valley. Elegant late‑19th and early‑20th‑century multi‑storey buildings line a narrow river or canal, with wooded hills rising sharply behind them. A small pavilion or lookout structure is visible on top of the hill. The scene is framed by tree branches at the top. In the lower left corner there is a caption in a script font reading "Weltbad Karlsbad."
